name: project-tracker
author: Ahmad Faaza Mubaarok <ahmadfaazamubaarok@gmail.com>
description: Cross-platform standalone Kanban Project Tracker for Desktop & Mobile

scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --mac
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap open ios
